intent: A first-run checklist with overall progress, each task's status as an icon and a word (Done, Current, To do, Blocked, Skipped) and at most one action per task. The current task's action, or its suggested provider's Connect, is the one solid primary. Built on kit Progress, Badge, Button and Empty, with IntegrationPicker's compact tile. Not a wizard stepper and not a bare Progress bar.
useWhen: onboard a new workspace with a short list of setup tasks
show how far setup is and what to do next
let people skip optional tasks and undo the skip
connect a provider straight from the task that needs it
doNotUseWhen: one value against a goal — Progress
an agent's plan of steps — AgentPlan

tasks.note: { id, label, description?, status: 'todo'|'current'|'done'|'skipped'|'blocked', actionLabel?, dependsOn?: id[], blockedReason?, integrations?: IntegrationItem[] }[]. A blocked task whose dependsOn tasks are all done shows as To do. integrations show as compact tiles under the row while it is current, and the row then has no button.

onTaskAction.note: (id) => void. The current task's action is the solid primary (default Continue); todo tasks get an outline Start. Blocked rows have no button.

onIntegrationConnect.note: (integrationId, taskId) => void. Connect on a provider tile under the current task. The first available tile is the solid primary; the rest are outline.

connectingId.note: That provider tile reads Connecting…, with no button, and is announced.

onUndoSkip.note: (id) => void. A ghost "Undo skip" Button on the skipped row.

onComplete.note: Go to dashboard, the one solid primary once every task is done or skipped.

requirements: tasks are an ordered list; the current task has aria-current=step
each row reads its name and a status word (Done, Current, To do, Blocked, Skipped); icons are aria-hidden, never colour alone
a blocked row has no button, so nothing disabled sits in the tab order; its reason is the row's description
each action button is described by its task label; provider tiles' Connect is described by the provider name
overall progress is a kit Progress with a text label ("1 of 4 done · 1 skipped")
Connecting is announced in a status region
the check scales and fades in (transform and opacity), off under prefers-reduced-motion
aria-busy while loading; the error is role=alert

doNot: Do not invent a local Checklist, OnboardingCard or SetupSteps
Do not use ProgressSteps for a checklist people can do in any order
Do not show more than one solid primary: the current task's action, or its suggested provider's Connect when tiles show
Do not put a disabled Start on a blocked task; say what unlocks it
snippet: <SetupGuide title="Set up billing" tasks={tasks} onTaskAction={openTask} onIntegrationConnect={connect} connectingId={connecting} onUndoSkip={undoSkip} onComplete={goToDashboard} onDismiss={dismiss} />
